description: This file defines the class em_mgr_t, which is an abstract base class for managing an event-driven system related to Wi-Fi mesh management. It contains virtual functions for initialization, node management, event handling, data model management, and periodic tasks, along with data members for synchronization and state tracking. It also includes method declarations for external interactions such as sending action frames, refreshing subdocuments, and managing network topology.

classes.name: em_mgr_t
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing Wi-Fi mesh network events, nodes, data models, and network topology. It serves as the central controller interface in the system, providing virtual functions for initialization, event handling, node management, and periodic tasks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the system with a specified data model path. Sets up environment and configurations for operation. Returns success or failure indicator.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the main management process or service, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: is_data_model_initialized
methods.description: Checks if the data model is initialized. Pure virtual; must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: push_to_queue
methods.description: Adds an event to the processing queue.

methods.name: pop_from_queue
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the next event from the queue.

methods.name: nodes_listen
methods.description: Listens for incoming data or signals from nodes.

methods.name: input_listen
methods.description: Listens for input events and processes them.

methods.name: proto_process
methods.description: Processes protocol data buffers.

methods.name: create_node
methods.description: Creates a new node with specific parameters, returning a pointer to it.

methods.name: delete_node
methods.description: Removes a node associated with the specified interface.

methods.name: delete_nodes
methods.description: Removes all nodes from the data structure.

methods.name: get_node_by_freq_band
methods.description: Retrieves a node matching a given frequency band.

methods.name: get_al_node
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the AL node.

methods.name: get_phy_al_node
methods.description: Returns the physical AL node used in EasyMesh operations.

methods.name: get_all_em_for_al_mac
methods.description: Populates a vector with all em_t nodes associated with a specific MAC.

methods.name: nodes_listener
methods.description: Handles node events.

methods.name: reset_listeners
methods.description: Resets all event listeners to their initial state.

methods.name: handle_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events.

methods.name: get_next_msg_id
methods.description: Returns the next message ID for CMDU headers, wrapping at 0xFFFF.

methods.name: mgr_nodes_listen
methods.description: Threaded function for listening to manager nodes.

methods.name: mgr_input_listen
methods.description: Threaded function for handling input events.

methods.name: int refresh_onewifi_subdoc(const char * log_name,const webconfig_subdoc_type_t type)
methods.description: Refreshes the OneWifi sub-document with current info and sends it; unimplemented, returns -2.

methods.name: bool send_action_frame(uint8_t dest_mac[ETH_ALEN],uint8_t * action_frame,size_t action_frame_len,unsigned int frequency=0,unsigned int wait_time_ms=0)
methods.description: Sends an action frame to a destination MAC. Optional to implement; default is not supported.

methods.name: bool send_backhaul_action_frame(uint8_t dest_mac[ETH_ALEN],uint8_t * action_frame,size_t action_frame_len,unsigned int frequency=0,unsigned int wait_time_ms=0)
methods.description: Sends a backhaul action frame. Optional; default is not supported.

methods.name: bool set_disconnected_steady_state()
methods.description: Sets device to an unstable steady state from disconnected scan; optional.

methods.name: bool set_disconnected_scan_none_state()
methods.description: Returns device to initial disconnected scan state; optional.

methods.name: bool send_scan_request(em_scan_params_t * scan_params,bool perform_fresh_scan,bool is_sta_vap=false)
methods.description: Sends a mesh scan request; optional support.

methods.name: bool can_onboard_additional_aps()
methods.description: Checks if extra APs can be onboarded; default is true; vendor-specific.

methods.name: bool is_agent_dpp_onboarding()
methods.description: Checks if currently DPP onboarding; default is false.

methods.name: io_process
